Remark
[conformal flatness of $N^2\times \mathbb {R}$]

Source: petersen:page-0177 1. ch4:4.7.20For $(N^2\times \mathbb {R},g_N+g_{\mathbb {R}})$: (1) show $P_{N\times \mathbb {R}}=\tfrac {\mathrm{scal}_N}2(g_N-g_{\mathbb {R}})$; (2) show this product metric is conformally flat iff $\mathrm{scal}_N$ is constant.
